about.title: Suisun City Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: Suisun City residents rely on everyday products — car parts, tools, appliances, machinery, children's items — trusting they'll work as intended. When something fails because of a design flaw, a manufacturing error, or a missing warning, the injuries can be severe and the medical bills fast-moving. California generally allows strict liability in these cases, meaning you don't have to prove the manufacturer was careless, only that the product was defective and that the defect caused your harm. That protection can extend to the manufacturer, the distributor, and the retailer who sold it. LawProactive is a free service, not a law firm, and we don't handle your case ourselves. Instead, we connect people across Suisun City and Solano County with an independent personal injury attorney who can evaluate what happened, help preserve the product as evidence, and explain your options — all on a contingency basis, so there's no fee unless you recover.

items.title: Strict Liability Can Simplify Your Path
items.desc: Because California often applies strict liability to defective products, you generally don't need to prove the manufacturer was negligent — just that the defect caused your injury.

items.title: Multiple Parties May Share Responsibility
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and retailers can all potentially be held liable, giving an attorney more avenues to pursue on your behalf.

items.title: Guidance on Preserving Evidence
items.desc: An independent attorney can advise you early on keeping the product itself intact, which is often critical to proving a defect claim.

items.question: Do I need to prove the manufacturer was negligent?
items.answer: Not necessarily. California product liability claims often proceed under strict liability, which generally focuses on whether the product was defective and caused your injury, rather than whether the manufacturer was careless. An independent attorney can review your situation and explain which legal theory fits best.

items.question: What should I do with the product that hurt me?
items.answer: Try to keep it exactly as it was at the time of the incident, including any packaging, parts, or instructions. Don't attempt repairs or throw it away, since the product itself is often the most important piece of evidence in these claims.

items.question: I was hurt near Highway 12 or Sunset Avenue in Suisun City — does location matter for a product claim?
items.answer: Where the injury happened can matter for gathering witnesses or records, but a product liability claim centers on the defect itself, not the specific road or corridor. If your injury involved a vehicle part or equipment failure near a busy Suisun City corridor, an attorney can help sort out whether it's a product issue, a traffic issue, or both.

items.question: Does LawProactive charge anything upfront?
items.answer: No. LawProactive is a free service that connects you with an independent attorney, and attorneys in the network typically work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless you recover compensation.
